item.title: Curfew and internet blackout imposed as fresh ethnic violence flares in India’s Manipur
item.description: ALBAWABA- Authorities in India’s northeastern state of Manipur imposed a curfew and suspended internet services across Ukhrul district on Tuesday, after renewed ethnic violence erupted in the Hill region, forcing residents to flee and destroying dozens of homes.The unrest, centered on Litan Sareikhong village in Ukhrul, a Naga-majority district bordering Myanmar, saw arson attacks and gunfire allegedly involving armed groups amid clashes between Naga and Kuki-Zo communities. item.title: Video: Tortoise miraculously escapes fire in California
item.description: ALBAWABA - CCTV footage obtained by ABC News recently flooded social media, capturing a pet tortoise miraculously escaping fire from its shed in California. Reports state that the tortoise named Leo escaped when a heat lamp fell inside the shed, igniting the fire. Leo's mom wasn't home at the time, but her neighbors saw the fire and rushed to put it out.
